CssSelector.description: W3C CssSelector: an element of an HTML page, chosen by a CSS selector.

refinedBy.description: A selector that narrows this one.

FragmentSelector.description: W3C FragmentSelector: a fragment of the source in the grammar that conformsTo names.

conformsTo.description: The IRI of the fragment grammar. Open: RFC 8118 (or its synonym RFC 3778) for PDF, RFC 5147 for text, RFC 3236 for HTML ids and Media Fragments get grammar checks; any other IRI passes with a warning.

refinedBy.description: A selector that narrows this one, such as a quote or a region inside a page= fragment.

PdfRegionSelector.description: formal-companion extension: a region of one PDF page. Exactly one of rect or quads.

coordinate_space.description: The coordinate system of rect or quads.

quads.description: Quadrilaterals that together cover the region.

rect.description: One rectangle that covers the region.

SitePageSelector.description: formal-companion extension: one page of a site source. An exporter composes the page IRI from the source and the path and drops this selector.

path.description: The page, relative to the site root. A path ending in / names its index.html.

TextQuoteSelector.description: W3C TextQuoteSelector: a span named by its exact text, with optional context.

exact.description: The quoted text, matched under the source's text_layer rules.

prefix.description: The text just before the quote.

refinedBy.description: A selector that narrows this one.

suffix.description: The text just after the quote.

artifact.description: graph profile: a formalization artifact that is not a declaration: a module doc, a #check, a figure.

file.description: The file it is in, relative to the companion's repository.

kind.description: What it is: module_doc (a module docstring), check (a #check or similar command), figure (a figure or diagram), other (anything else).

module.description: The Lean module it is in.

change.description: history profile: one id event. A retired id is never reused.

at.description: When the event happened: a date or a UTC timestamp.

commit.description: ordinal_assigned: the companion commit at which the ordinal was assigned.

event.description: What happened to the subject: born (the id appeared), retired (the id is gone for good; links to a retired declaration stay as orphaned), restated (the statement of a declared, named or private declaration id changed), renamed (the same thing under a new id, the successor), ordinal_assigned (which declaration, by its file, took a ~k statement-hash id).

file.description: ordinal_assigned: the file of the declaration that took the ~k id; the checker compares the latest record with the live declaration's file.

line.description: The subject's 1-based line, when it has one.

new_statement_sha256.description: restated: the statement hash after the change.

old_statement_sha256.description: restated: the statement hash before the change.

possible_successor.description: A live id that may replace the subject. A suggestion: nothing moves automatically.

reason.description: retired: why. statement_changed (the statement changed, and with it a statement-hash id), removed (deleted), renamed (renamed with no renamed record), moved (moved elsewhere), other.

subject.description: The id the event is about.

subject_kind.description: The array the subject's id is in: declaration, item, location or artifact.

successor.description: renamed: the new id, live in the document.

cluster.description: graph profile: a companion's own coarse node (a section, a node of its dependency graph). Its declarations are memberships.

locator.description: Where the node sits in the source, in the graph's own words.

related_to.description: Other clusters this one is related to.

companion.description: The companion repository and the commit the document describes.

generator.description: The tool, with its version, that wrote the document, or 'hand'.

graph.description: graph profile: the companion's own dependency graph, pinned.

packages.description: The companion's dependencies, sorted by name, one entry per name.

repo.description: The repository, as host/org/name with no scheme.

coordinate_space.description: top_left pairs with down, bottom_left with up. normalized means [0, 1] of the page box.

origin.description: The corner the coordinates count from: top_left (y grows down) or bottom_left (y grows up).

page_box.description: The PDF page box the coordinates are relative to.

units.description: normalized (fractions of the page box, in [0, 1]) or pt (points, 1/72 inch, from the origin).

y_axis.description: The direction y grows: down (with top_left) or up (with bottom_left).

date_or_timestamp.description: A calendar date (the start of that day, UTC) or a UTC timestamp written with Z.

declaration.description: One Lean declaration or structure member. line is a location, never part of the id.

anchors.description: Locations that show the declaration's own text, on a lean, web or other text source.

anonymous.description: Lean gives it no name: an example, or an instance without a name.

doc_line.description: The 1-based line its docstring starts on.

file.description: The .lean file it is in, relative to the companion's repository (or to package).

id.description: The record's id, formed as id_source says.

id_source.description: How the id was formed: name (the fully qualified name), private (private:<module>:<name>), statement_hash (<keyword>:<12 hex of statement_sha256>, with ~k for the k-th duplicate), declared (<keyword>:<slug>, an id the companion declares for an anonymous declaration).

kind.description: The Lean keyword (theorem, lemma, def, abbrev, structure, class, inductive, instance, example, opaque, axiom, alias, irreducible_def) or a member's kind: field and projection (of a structure or class), constructor and recursor (of an inductive, structure or class).

lean_name.description: The name Lean gives it, when that differs (a generated instance name, a _private name).

legacy_ids.description: Ids the declaration had in older formats.

line.description: The 1-based line of its keyword. Never part of the id.

module.description: The Lean module it is in.

name.description: The declared, fully qualified name. Absent on an anonymous declaration (an example, an instance without a name).

namespace.description: The enclosing namespace at the declaration; the empty string for the root. For a member (field, projection, constructor, recursor), the parent's full name, so namespace + "." + the member's own name is its full name.

package.description: The Lake package the declaration lives in when it is not the companion (e.g. mathlib); file is relative to that package.

parent.description: Members only: the structure or class a field or projection belongs to; the inductive, structure or class a constructor or recursor belongs to.

replaced_by.description: history profile: the declaration that supersedes this one.

signature.description: The display form of the header (specification section 5.2): from the keyword to the end of the header, each comment replaced by one space, whitespace collapsed. statement_sha256 hashes its hash form. Omitted when no := or where ends the header.

sorry.description: Whether its proof holds a sorry: exercise (left on purpose, for the reader to do), gap (work not done yet), none (no sorry).

statement_sha256.description: The sha256 of the signature's hash form (specification section 5.3). Required on an anonymous declaration unless it is unlocated.

unlocated.description: graph profile: a declared id not yet found in the Lean at companion.commit: no statement, line or anchors yet.

destination.description: site profile: where a declaration or artifact is rendered on a companion site. An artifact target needs the graph profile too.

artifact.description: The artifact rendered. Needs the graph profile too.

fallback_label.description: With resolution fallback: what to show in place of an anchor.

fragment.description: With resolution exact: the element id on the page, without #.

href.description: A site-relative path (the site_path grammar that SitePageSelector.path uses) or an https URL.

resolution.description: exact (the page has an anchor for the target, given in fragment) or fallback (it has none; fallback_label says what to show).

site.description: The kind of site: verso_literate (a Verso literate page), doc_gen4 (doc-gen4 API documentation), blueprint (a blueprint site), other.

git_sha.description: A full git object id: 40 hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

git_sha_abbrev.description: A git object id, abbreviations allowed. Used only in a verdict's resolution.

graph_lock.description: graph profile: the companion's own dependency graph that memberships were read from, pinned by bytes; snapshot_commit is the commit its graph describes when that is not companion.commit.

bytes.description: The graph file's size in bytes.

path.description: The graph file, relative to the companion's repository.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the graph file's bytes.

snapshot_commit.description: The commit the graph describes, when it lags companion.commit.

id.description: A record id: unique within its array, never reused once retired, no whitespace.

identifiers.description: Bibliographic identifiers of the edition: at least one of doi, isbn, arxiv. On a pdf or other source they may be its only identity (no sha256): then no PdfRegionSelector may be used on it.

arxiv.description: An arXiv identifier with its version, new style (2301.00001v2) or old style (math.AG/0601001v1).

input_lock.description: One input a producer read: a file pinned by its bytes ({path, sha256, bytes?, commit?}), or a source of this document ({source}).

commit.description: The commit the file was read at.

path.description: A file of the companion, relative to its repository.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the file's bytes.

item.description: A source item, discriminated by form.

clusters.description: graph profile: the coarse nodes the item belongs to.

coverage.description: The curator's class for the item; invariant I5 ties it to the item's links. formalized (a key link states the whole item), partial_only (the linked declarations state a special case or one part, none all of it), support_only (only a neighbouring item is stated), example_only (only anonymous examples, linked with role example, state it), private_only (only a private declaration states it), not_formalized (nothing states it), out_of_scope (the companion does not set out to formalise it).

coverage_note.description: The curator's note on the coverage class. Only with coverage.

form.description: The discriminator: numbered (kind + number) or passage (unnumbered).

id.description: The record's id, formed as id_source says.

id_source.description: How the id was formed (specification section 5.5): label (<kind>-<number>[-<sub>]), quote_hash (passage-<8 hex of the normalised quote>), page_title_hash (passage-p<printed page>-<8 hex of the normalised title>), declared (chosen by the producer).

kind.description: The kind word (Definition, Exercise, ...), or passage for unlabelled prose.

kind_source.description: Whose word kind is: source (the source's, the default) or producer (the producer's).

label.description: The label as the source prints it.

legacy_ids.description: Ids the item had in older formats.

number.description: The source's number, e.g. 1.1.21. Numbered items only.

pages.description: A page span without geometry. Required for a page_title_hash id.

quote.description: A quote that anchors the item on its whole source.

section.description: The source's own section the item sits in, as the source names it.

source.description: The source the item is in.

sub.description: A part the source numbers or locates separately, written without parentheses: ii, 3, ix,x, b'. A prime stays.

title.description: The item's title. Required on a passage.

title_source.description: Whose words title is: source (the source's, the default) or producer (the producer's).

xrefs.description: The same statement in public databases, sorted by (database, tag), no duplicates: the cross-document pairing key.

cluster.description: graph profile: the cluster the link targets.

locations.description: Locations for this link alone, on the item's source.

note.description: A short free-text note on the link.

orphaned.description: history profile: the declaration was retired (see changelog) and nobody has re-attached this link.

pages.description: The page the link's own tag gives; it may differ from the item's.

provenance.description: The provenance record of the link.

relation.description: How the declaration relates to the item's text. An open lower-case snake_case token; the documented core is exact, generalization, special_case, part, invocation, related, and another token passes with a warning.

role.description: What the link claims: key (the target states the whole item), attributed (shown for the item, not key), support (a supporting result), example (a worked example), helper (a helper used in the proof).

sub.description: The part of the item this link covers, written without parentheses, as item.sub.

location.description: Where something sits in a source: a W3C target plus the items it shows. Its source is target.source.

id.description: The record's id. Recommended for a PDF location: <item>@p<page>.

items.description: The items the location shows, on its source. May be empty when a declaration's anchors or a link's locations name the location.

legacy_ids.description: Ids the location had in older formats.

pages.description: The PDF pages the selectors name, as a structured mirror.

provenance.description: The provenance record of the location.

signoff.description: Who checked the location against the source.

target.description: The W3C target: the source and the selectors.

media_type.description: An IANA media type in lower case, without parameters: text/markdown, video/mp4.

membership.description: graph profile: a declaration or artifact that belongs to a cluster, with the role the companion's graph gives it.

artifact.description: The artifact that belongs to the cluster.

declaration.description: The declaration that belongs to the cluster.

provenance.description: The provenance record of the membership.

role.description: The role the companion's graph gives the member: primary (it states the node), support (it supports the node), consumer (it uses the node).

package.description: A dependency of the companion: its Lake package name and the full git id it is pinned to.

rev.description: The full git id it is pinned to.

page_hash.description: One page of a site source: its path relative to the site root and the sha256 of its bytes.

path.description: The page file, relative to the site root.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the page's bytes.

page_size.description: The page box's size in points (1/72 inch).

height_pt.description: The page box's height in points.

width_pt.description: The page box's width in points.

page_size_range.description: Physical pages first..last that differ from page_size.

height_pt.description: The page box's height in points.

width_pt.description: The page box's width in points.

pages.description: A page span without geometry, on a PDF source. last defaults to first.

anchor.description: Where the page came from: own (the thing's own anchor), crossref (a cross-reference to it), inferred (from a neighbour).

basis.description: The numbering first and last use: printed (the numbers the source prints) or physical (the 1-based pages of the file).

last.description: The last page. Defaults to first.

raw.description: The page anchor as the companion wrote it, verbatim (book pp. 25-26).

provenance.description: How links, locations or memberships were produced: who, how, and from what.

actor.description: Who produced the records: author (the companion's author), agent (an AI agent), human (another person), tool (a program).

at.description: When: a date or a UTC timestamp.

inputs.description: Sorted: file entries by path, then source entries by source; one entry each.

method.description: How: docstring_tag (tags in docstrings), curation (a person's curation), blueprint_macro (a blueprint's \lean{} macros), lean_scan (a scan of the Lean source), layout_extraction (the source's page layout), text_match (matching text), manual (written by hand), agent_annotation (an agent's annotation), pipeline (a multi-step pipeline), adjudication (an adjudicated audit), site_index (a rendered site's index).

tool.description: The program that produced the records.

path.description: The program's path, relative to the companion's repository.

x0.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

x1.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

x2.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

x3.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y0.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y1.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y2.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y3.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

quote.description: Shorthand for a location on the item's source with one TextQuoteSelector and no page (specification section 5.5).

exact.description: The quoted text, matched under the source's text_layer rules.

prefix.description: The text just before the quote.

suffix.description: The text just after the quote.

rect.description: An axis-aligned box; x0 < x1 and y0 < y1.

x0.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

x1.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y0.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

y1.description: A coordinate in the coordinate_space's units.

ref.description: The id of a record in another array. The validator checks it resolves.

relations.description: Typed links between items: same_as (the same content, e.g. another edition), part_of (contained in), near (the numbered neighbour a passage sits beside, as its tag names it; the passage's page may be inferred from it).

near.description: The numbered neighbours a passage sits beside, as its tag names them; its page may be inferred from them.

part_of.description: The items that contain this one.

same_as.description: Items with the same content: an entry in another edition or an errata list.

repo_path.description: A repo-relative path: no leading slash, no .. segment.

repo_ref.description: A repository named without a scheme, e.g. host/org/name. Keeps http(s) URLs out of the document body.

resolution.description: How a verdict was resolved. A verdict without one is open.

branch.description: The branch a fix is under way on.

commits.description: Sorted. The fix and merge commits.

replaced_by.description: Every declaration that replaces the item's declarations.

state.description: open (nobody has resolved the verdict), fixed (the defect is fixed; names pr or commits), in_progress (a fix is under way; names pr or branch), refuted (the suspected defect's premise was wrong), argued_correct (the statement is argued to be right as it stands), out_of_scope (closed without a fix: outside what the companion sets out to formalise).

selector.description: A selector, discriminated by type: the W3C Web Annotation classes FragmentSelector, TextQuoteSelector and CssSelector, and the two formal-companion extensions PdfRegionSelector and SitePageSelector.

type.description: The selector type: FragmentSelector, TextQuoteSelector and CssSelector (the W3C classes), PdfRegionSelector and SitePageSelector (the two extensions).

sha256.description: A sha256 digest: 64 lowercase hex digits.

signoff.description: Who checked this location against the source, and how.

evidence_id.description: The producer's own id for the evidence.

site_path.description: A page's path relative to the site root: no leading slash, no .. segment, no fragment and no colon (so it never reads as a URL scheme).

snippet.description: site profile: statement text for a declaration card.

declaration.description: The declaration the snippet shows. At most one snippet per declaration.

line.description: The 1-based line the text starts on.

source.description: One edition of one source, pinned by content (sha256, git_blob, a site's page manifest), by an immutable revision, or (pdf and other) by bibliographic identifiers alone.

alternate_urls.description: Other addresses of the same bytes (a canonical page, a mirror). Sorted.

edition.description: The edition, as the source names it.

git_blob.description: git blob id of the file (equals the SWHID swh:1:cnt core).

identifiers.description: Bibliographic identifiers of the edition: the identity of a pdf or other source whose bytes the producer does not hold.

kind.description: The medium: pdf (a PDF file), web (a web page, or with scope site a rendered site), tex (a LaTeX file), lean (a Lean file), other (any other medium, named by media_type).

media_type.description: With kind other: the medium's IANA media type.

page_hashes.description: scope site only: the pages the producer pins, {path, sha256}, sorted by path, each path a file. Required when the site source has a sha256, which is then the sha256 of the manifest these entries give (specification section 4.5). Must list every page a SitePageSelector on the source names.

page_size.description: PDF only: the page box's size.

page_sizes.description: PDF only: exceptions to page_size, sorted by first.

path.description: The file or site root, relative to the companion's repository.

physical_page_count.description: PDF only: the number of pages in the file.

printed_page_offset.description: PDF only: physical page = printed page + offset.

retrieved_at.description: When the source was fetched. Never part of its identity.

revision.description: An immutable revision: a wiki oldid, a git commit, an edition stamp.

role.description: The source's role: audited (a companion is checked against it) or reference (kept only so a page map to a sibling edition can be checked). Core: it needs no profile.

scope.description: page (the default: one page or file) or site (one web source for a whole rendered site; each location chooses its page with a SitePageSelector, and sha256 is the sha256 of the page manifest).

sha256.description: The sha256 of the source's bytes; for a site, of its page manifest.

text_layer.description: How quotes on this source are matched.

target.description: A W3C SpecificResource. source is a source id, and the location's source; an exporter swaps in that source's IRI.

selector.description: Alternatives in preference order: each selects the same span. Never a union.

text_layer.description: How quotes on this source are matched. extractor and version come together: both or neither.

case.description: Letter case when matching: sensitive or insensitive.

extractor.description: The program that produced the text offsets count in, e.g. pdftotext.

unicode.description: The normalisation applied before matching: none, nfc or nfkc.

whitespace.description: How whitespace is compared: exact (as written), collapse (each run as one space), ignore (not at all).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time in UTC, written with Z.

unattributed.description: A declaration the companion shows but ties to no item.

claim.description: Why it is tied to no item: unattributed (nobody has attributed it), api (library API that states no item), infrastructure (machinery that states no item).

verdict.description: audit profile: an adjudicated verdict on an item. A producer's own finding ids and kinds go in x_ keys.

declarations.description: A verdict per declaration, sorted by declaration, one each.

verdict.description: The verdict on this declaration, in the values of the verdict's own verdict.

evidence.description: The evidence behind the verdict, in the order it was recorded.

item.description: The item the verdict is on.

locations.description: The regions the verdict is about. Each shows the item.

provenance.description: The provenance record of the verdict.

resolution.description: How the verdict was resolved. Absent means open.

severity.description: The defect's weight, ordered none < low < medium < high: none (no defect to weigh), low, medium and high (a real defect of the least, middle or greatest weight).

status.description: unconfirmed (as a machine pass wrote it), contested (the adjudication recorded dissent it did not settle), human_confirmed (a human confirmed it), fixed (the defect is fixed; the resolution's state is fixed).

sub.description: The part of the item, written as item.sub.

verdict.description: faithful (the declarations state what the item says), convention (they differ only by a documented encoding or degenerate-case choice, or the printed text diverges and an errata entry says so), attribution_gap (a faithful statement exists, but not in the declaration attributed), proxy (they are about a stand-in for the item's notion), deviation (they assert something materially different, or leave out a main clause).

xref.description: The same statement in a public database: database is an open lower-case snake_case token (the core is stacks, kerodon, wikidata, lmfdb; another passes with a warning), tag the entry's tag.

database.description: The database: an open lower-case snake_case token. The core is stacks, kerodon, wikidata and lmfdb; another token passes with warning W-XREF.

description: One document per companion: which Lean declarations formalise which items of which sources, and where those items sit in the sources. The locations are W3C Web Annotation targets. The prose specification is docs/annotations.md; this project's checker, the formal-companion-annotations-validate command (src/formal_companion_annotations/validate.py), checks this schema plus the semantic invariants no JSON Schema can state (references resolve, arrays sorted by id, the coverage rules, the profile gating, selector grammars, the id rules). The core is the header and the arrays sources, items, declarations, links, provenance, locations and unattributed; the other root arrays belong to the four profiles a document declares in its profiles object (audit: verdicts; graph: clusters, memberships, artifacts; history: changelog; site: destinations, snippets). The $id is one per format minor and never changes after release; it is an identifier, validators never fetch it, and documents need not carry $schema.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema the document follows: an identifier, never fetched. When present it should be the $id of the schema of the declared schema_version.

artifacts.description: graph profile: formalization artifacts that are not declarations. Sorted by id.

changelog.description: history profile: id events. Sorted by id.

clusters.description: graph profile: the companion's own coarse nodes. Sorted by id.

companion.description: The companion repository and the commit the document describes.

declarations.description: Every declaration the document names. Sorted by id.

destinations.description: site profile: where declarations and artifacts are rendered. Sorted by id.

items.description: The numbered items and passages of the sources. Sorted by id.

links.description: Attributions of items to declarations (or, with the graph profile, to clusters). Sorted by id.

locations.description: Where items, and the declarations' own text, sit in the sources. Sorted by id.

memberships.description: graph profile: the declarations and artifacts each cluster holds. Sorted by id.

profiles.description: The profiles the document uses, each with its own <major>.<minor>. A root array or field a profile owns appears only when that profile is declared (invariant I14). May be absent or empty.

graph.description: The graph profile's version (clusters, memberships, artifacts and the fields they need).

history.description: The history profile's version (changelog, link.orphaned, declaration.replaced_by).

provenance.description: How the links, locations and memberships were produced. Sorted by id.

schema.description: The format identifier. No other value is accepted.

schema_version.description: <major>.<minor> of the core. Readers match the major; a writer declares the lowest minor whose schema admits the document.

snippets.description: site profile: statement text for declaration cards. Sorted by id.

sources.description: The editions annotated, at least one. Sorted by id.

unattributed.description: Declarations tied to no item, with the reason. Sorted by id.

verdicts.description: audit profile: adjudicated verdicts on items. Sorted by id.
